name: print-social-dark-workflow-overview-post-with-pink-progress-ring
title: Dark 'Sample workflow overview' post with a pink progress ring carousel of stages
whatItIs: A near-black portrait post with a white logo badge, a large 'Sample workflow overview' title, and a central ring gauge with a hot-pink progress stroke around 'Retention and conversion', flanked by faded rings for 'Awareness and reach' and 'Engagement and follow-up', plus avatar social proof at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Focused and product-like; the faded neighbours imply a sequence, like a UI carousel frozen mid-swipe.
techniques: Show one step in focus with neighbours faded to the sides.
Use a progress ring to show stage completion.
Add a soft colour glow behind the focal element.
Close with a row of avatars as social proof.

vocabulary.definition: A circular stroke showing a percentage.
A row where the centre item is sharp and neighbours faded.
